description: Test suite for the MemoryStore implementation of the pluginapi in Mattermost, focusing on set, get, delete, list, and concurrency behaviors.

methods.name: TestMemoryStoreSet
methods.description: Tests the Set method of MemoryStore, including error cases, atomic operations, expiry, and concurrency.

methods.name: TestMemoryStoreSetAtomicWithRetries
methods.description: Tests the SetAtomicWithRetries method of MemoryStore, including error handling and race conditions.

methods.name: TestMemoryStoreListKeys
methods.description: Tests the ListKeys method of MemoryStore, including pagination, filtering, and expiry.

methods.name: TestMemoryStoreGet
methods.description: Tests the Get method of MemoryStore with various data types.

methods.name: TestMemoryStoreDelete
methods.description: Tests the Delete method of MemoryStore for idempotency.

methods.name: TestMemoryStoreDeleteAll
methods.description: Tests the DeleteAll method of MemoryStore for idempotency and clearing all keys.

methods.name: isNil
methods.description: Helper function to verify that a key is not present or has a nil value in MemoryStore.
